description: This file is a shell script containing a collection of test setups and test cases for Git merge conflict scenarios, focusing heavily on rename, merge, and conflict detection cases.

methods.name: test_setup_rename_delete_untracked
methods.description: Initializes a repository, creates a file, commits, renames, deletes, and untracked modifications to test rename-delete untracked behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs a scenario, and verifies outcomes.

methods.name: test_setup_rename_modify_add_source
methods.description: Sets up a repository with specific commits involving renames, modifications, and additions to test rename/modify/add-source merge scenarios.

methods.name: test_setup_break_detection_1
methods.description: Creates a specific merge scenario with renames and modifications to observe break detection behavior in git merges.

methods.name: test_setup_break_detection_2
methods.description: Creates another complex merge scenario with renames and modifications for break detection testing.

methods.name: test_setup_break_detection_3
methods.description: Sets up a scenario with multiple rename and add-source conflicts to test conflict detection and resolution.

methods.name: test_setup_rename_directory
methods.description: Prepares a repository with directory renames and conflicts to test directory-specific merge conflict handling.

methods.name: test_setup_rename_with_content_merge_and_add
methods.description: Sets up a scenario involving renames with content merges and add-source conflicts to test complex rename/merge behavior.

methods.name: test_setup_rename_with_content_merge_and_add BA
methods.description: Variant of the above with different branch configurations for symmetrical testing.

methods.name: test_setup_rename_with_content_merge_and_add AB
methods.description: Variant of the above with different branch configurations for symmetrical testing.

methods.name: test_setup_rename_directory_2
methods.description: Prepares a directory rename conflict scenario involving nested directories for testing directory merge conflicts.

methods.name: test_setup_rename_with_content_merge_and_add AB
methods.description: Prepares a scenario involving rename, content merge, and add-source conflicts between branches.

methods.name: test_setup_rename_with_content_merge_and_add BA
methods.description: Prepares a symmetrical branch setup for testing various merge conflict resolutions.

methods.name: test_setup_rename_rename_2to1
methods.description: Establishes a merge scenario with files renamed across different branches, including modifications, to test rename/rename conflicts (2to1).

methods.name: test_setup_rename_rename_1to2
methods.description: Establishes a merge scenario with files renamed differently across branches, testing rename/rename (1to2) conflicts.

methods.name: test_setup_rename_rename_1to2_add_source_1
methods.description: Creates a scenario with a new file, renames, and conflicting additions to test conflict detection with rename/rename + add-source.

methods.name: test_setup_rename_rename_1to2_add_source_2
methods.description: Sets up a scenario with renames and new files to test detection of conflicts involving rename/rename and add-source.

methods.name: test_setup_rename_rename_1to2_add_dest
methods.description: Prepares a scenario with renames and conflicting added files to test merge conflict resolution involving renames and additions.

methods.name: test_setup_rad
methods.description: Creates a rename/add/delete conflict scenario with a file renamed and deleted across branches.

methods.name: test_setup_rrdd
methods.description: Sets up rename/rename/delete/delete conflicting scenario for conflict detection testing.

methods.name: test_setup_mod6
methods.description: Creates a chain of renames and modifications across branches for testing complex rename conflicts.

methods.name: test_conflicts_with_adds_and_renames
methods.description: Defines a parameterized test for conflict handling with different combinations of renames and adds, involving conflict detection and content merge scenarios.

methods.name: test_setup_collision_conflict
methods.description: Sets up files and renames to simulate and verify conflict detection in complex merge scenarios involving renames and conflicting content.
